public_rationale: Anthropic's statement of June 12, 2026 says the US government issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, inside or outside the US, including Anthropic's own foreign-national employees. Marcus's quote matches that wording. Fortune reported the next day that the US Commerce Department issued the directive, and that it covered Anthropic's non-citizen employees. Every part of the claim holds: the agency, the export control framing, both models, foreign nationals, and employees.
limitations: No government copy of the directive was cited. The agency is named in Fortune's reporting, not in Anthropic's statement.
Access was later restored. That does not affect whether the directive was issued as described.
